Draft created. The s5 report task is complete. Here's the summary.

## Run 49 (2026-06-17) — s5 Report Stage: Complete ✅

**Deliverables, all done:**
- ✅ `OVERNIGHT-REPORT.md` — rewritten for Run 49 with all required sections (summary, backend, frontend, UI audit, verify, bugs fixed, known issues, coverage gaps)
- ✅ `docs/overnight-history.md` — Run 49 entry **appended** (not overwritten)
- ✅ `overnight_resume.md` — prepended s5-report "RUN COMPLETE" section
- ✅ Committed: `1941671 docs: QA report 2026-06-17 (Run 49)`
- ✅ Final build: `npx vite build` clean, **7.56s** (only pre-existing mapbox/Reports chunk-size warnings)
- ✅ Email: Gmail **draft** prepared to brandon@accessvaletparking.com (Gmail integration exposes only `create_draft` — no programmatic send tool, same as prior runs; draft is ready to send)

**What tonight's run actually produced — 1 code commit:**

`8f55a02` — the run's headline: **the first real axe-core accessibility sweep** (a gap carried 8+ runs). Three WCAG violations found and fixed in one commit, all verified at runtime by s4:
1. **Tasks** — toggle buttons missing accessible name (axe `button-name`, critical, 15 nodes)
2. **Work Orders** — scrollable kanban not keyboard-accessible (`scrollable-region-focusable`, serious)
3. **Calendar** — FullCalendar chevrons `role=img` without alt (`role-img-alt`, serious, 2 nodes)

Backend (9th converged run, 272 routes/~1,330 reqs, 0 5xx) and UI-consistency (6th converged audit) both clean, 0 fixes.

**Two things I want to flag honestly:**
- **Run-number discrepancy:** s3/s4 self-labeled "Run 50," but canonical is **Run 49** (history's last entry was Run 48 on 2026-06-16; backend's 9th consecutive run = 41–49). I used Run 49 and noted the recurring off-by-one in the report.
- **Loose end:** s2 hit the 80-turn limit and abandoned a keyboard-nav effort, leaving an **uncommitted, unused `import useEffect`** in `client/src/components/ImportLeadsModal.jsx`. It's harmless dead code (build passes), and prior stages deliberately left it — I did too (out of scope for s5), but documented it as the #1 known issue / next-run cleanup.

The keyboard-nav sweep (Esc-to-close app-wide) and finishing the tablet-768px sweep are the highest-value gaps carried forward.
